title: Evaluating Pancreatic Tumors in Patients With Zollinger-Ellison Syndrome
brief_summary: This protocol concerns the approach to the localization, diagnosis of MEN1 and management of the tumor and the tissue samples in patients with Zollinger-Ellison syndrome. It details the diagnostic imaging tests to be used to localize the tumor, investigations for MEN1 the subsequent management of the tumor and tissue samples for research.
raw_criteria:
* INCLUSION CRITERIA:

New patients will be evaluated initially as described in the protocol entitled, "Diagnostic evaluation of patients with suspected abnormalities of gastric secretion" (89-DK-0005).

Only those patients that are being treated under the protocol entitled, "Medical Therapy of Zollinger-Ellison Syndrome" (protocol # 89-DK-0015) will be entered into this tumor localization and management protocol.
line_of_therapy_overall_summary: This trial focuses on the localization, diagnosis, and management of pancreatic tumors in patients with Zollinger-Ellison syndrome, but does not specify requirements regarding prior systemic therapy for advanced disease. The line-of-therapy intent is not clearly defined in the available protocol text.

cohort_line_of_therapy.line_of_therapy_text: The eligibility criteria do not mention prior systemic therapy for advanced or metastatic disease, nor do they specify inclusion or exclusion based on prior adjuvant or neoadjuvant therapy. Line-of-therapy intent is not addressed in the protocol description.
